paragraphs: Sabre Industries supplies highly-engineered critical infrastructure for power utilities, telecom, and data centers. Products listed under power and utility infrastructure include engineered transmission structures, light duty structures, substation structures, solar structures, and coatings and finishes. Telecom infrastructure listings include self-supporting structures, monopoles, guyed structures, concealed and decorative structures, small cell solutions, and mounts and components.

Building systems listings include uninterruptable power supply pods, integrated equipment skids and platforms, battery energy storage, fiber access hubs, telecom equipment enclosures, and a substation control house. The site credits 200+ engineers and drafters with the design challenges facing custodians of mission-critical infrastructure. Manufacturing and office space runs to more than 2.3 million square feet. The company page puts the same three markets together as power and utility, telecom, and data center structures.
